title: Weighted carrier matching: conditional κ = 4.100629254e-5 > 2^-15
body:
Under the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad \kappa=\frac{2050314627}{5\cdot10^{13}}=4.100629254\times10^{-5}>2^{-15}.$$

This conditional exponent saving is approximately **0.02681% above #43** and **0.02768% above #42**. The bit saving is `4100797413/10^14 = 4.100797413e-5`. These compare asymptotic exponents, not practical running times.

The branch pins a different maximum-cardinality carrier matching and applies descending summand order at h25 as well as h23. Legal carrier choices change the complete fixed-basis child profile while retaining role counts 36,685 / 48,479, W=178,378,409, and total rank 102,565,738,275. All paid endpoint corrections and #43's ten conservative data-corner fallbacks remain charged. The complex construction and inherited balanced assembly remain unchanged.

**Full verification PASSED** at research commit `061414a529f1123668872db44d737e362fbe066f`: **189 tests**, all five focused tests, fresh pinned-link profiles and independent physical timeline/dirty-basis replay at both dimensions, complete inherited 4,073,300-pair data geometry, inherited producer rebuilds and **18 historical patch checks**. Completed 2026-10-08T14:32:42.236190+00:00; log SHA256 `53b681f078fa65af6d0c05f5b9cf63101db89aa2a066d20b7202cc1282dda203`. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/optimal-carrier-matching/research/optimal-matching/validation.json). Follow-up edits change documentation and receipt metadata only.

**Optimizer scope for review:** the supplied optimizer uses floating-point logarithmic weights and SciPy assignment for a first-order objective. Its output is a pinned candidate, not an exact rational certificate of optimality for the nonlinear characteristic. Validity of the claimed bound rests on independently checking the pinned matching and exact characteristic, not on an optimality claim. The research README now distinguishes the numerical search objective from the exact certificate for its pinned output. No global optimality or formal verification of the complete multiplication theorem is claimed.

Reproduction:

```sh
make optimal-matching-verify
make verify
```

See `research/optimal-matching/README.md`, `witness.py`, `SOURCE.json`, the pinned links and producer receipts. This branch is based on #43 at `c0fbfd3cc4fd6e95cef54ab307dfb50c69dd96f6`.
